dslRule:
<!id: add-java11-javacore-version>
<!description: Adds JavaCore.VERSION_11 to array initializers containing compliance versions, typically when updating compiler preferences to support newer Java versions.>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.lang.String[] { $args$, org.eclipse.jdt.core.JavaCore.VERSION_10 }
=>
new java.lang.String[] { $args$, org.eclipse.jdt.core.JavaCore.VERSION_10, org.eclipse.jdt.core.JavaCore.VERSION_11 }
;;
summary: Add JavaCore.VERSION_11 to string array literals that end with JavaCore.VERSION_10.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
